author: DamiLee
description:
Ever wondered what life was actually like for the average Roman citizen?

Follow a Roman pleb from waking up in a cramped apartment to joining tens of thousands at the Colosseum. The Colosseum wasn't just entertainment. It was one of history's greatest tools for keeping the population happy. From the gladiators to the grand entrances, Ancient Rome knew exactly how to keep the masses distracted.
